data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: try
data_tooling.summary: Try 是一个极简的 Shell 工具，专为解决项目文件散乱问题而设计，通过为不同任务或心情创建全新的隔离目录。它采用生成唯一命名临时工作区的方式，让用户能自由实验而不污染主目录，体现了“环境隔离”的实用设计思想。你可以用它快速原型开发、测试脚本或组织创意工作流，只需运行“try”加活动名称即可开始，完成后删除目录即恢复整洁。
data_tooling.summary_en: Try is a minimalist shell utility that creates fresh, isolated directories for different tasks or moods, addressing the clutter of scattered project files. It works by generating temporary workspaces with unique names, allowing users to experiment freely without polluting their main directories. You can use it for quick prototyping, testing scripts, or organizing creative workflows by simply running 'try' followed by your activity name, then deleting the directory when done.

ui_devex.name: yt-dlp
ui_devex.summary: yt-dlp 是一款功能强大的命令行音视频下载工具，能够从数千个网站下载媒体内容，解决用户需要离线访问或保存网络视频的实际需求。它通过精心设计的站点提取器架构智能解析不同平台的媒体流，支持自动合并视频与音频轨道，并可应用后处理滤镜优化输出质量。用户只需简单命令即可下载指定画质的视频、提取纯音频文件，或将其集成到自动化脚本中批量处理教学资料、技术讲座等有价值内容，非常适合媒体收藏和内容分析场景。
ui_devex.summary_en: yt-dlp is a powerful command-line tool that solves the practical problem of downloading videos and audio from thousands of websites when you need offline access or want to archive content. It works by intelligently extracting media streams through extensive site-specific extractors and can merge multiple formats while supporting post-processing filters. You can use it via simple commands to download specific quality formats, extract audio only, or integrate it into scripts for batch processing your favorite educational or entertainment content.

ui_devex.name: nautilus_trader
ui_devex.summary: Nautilus Trader 是一个高性能算法交易平台，专为需要构建可靠、低延迟交易系统的开发者和研究人员设计。它采用 Rust 语言编写，通过内存安全和高效的事件驱动架构，实现了跨资产类别（如加密货币、股票、期货）的快速回测和实盘交易。技术亮点在于其模块化设计，允许用户轻松集成自定义策略和机器学习模型，并在模拟环境中验证性能。你可以用它开发自动化交易算法，结合市场数据进行分析，或作为研究工具来测试新的量化交易理念。
ui_devex.summary_en: Nautilus Trader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform that solves the challenge of building reliable, low-latency trading systems for professionals and researchers. Its technical strength lies in being written primarily in Rust, which provides memory safety and exceptional speed for event-driven backtesting and live trading across multiple asset classes. You can use it to develop custom trading strategies, integrate machine learning models, and test them with realistic market data simulations before deploying to exchanges like crypto, equities, or forex.

ui_devex.name: VoxCPM
ui_devex.summary: VoxCPM 是一个开源文本转语音模型，无需语音克隆标记即可生成自然且上下文感知的语音，适用于需要逼真语音合成的场景。其无分词器架构直接处理原始音频波形，实现了更灵活的语音适配，并降低了对大量训练数据的依赖。开发者可通过 Python 使用该模型创建自定义语音界面、尝试语音个性化或集成到辅助技术中，为探索先进 TTS 功能提供了实用工具。
ui_devex.summary_en: VoxCPM is an open-source text-to-speech model that generates natural, context-aware speech without requiring voice cloning tokens, making it accessible for applications needing realistic voice synthesis. Its tokenizer-free architecture directly processes raw audio waveforms, enabling more flexible voice adaptation and reducing dependency on extensive training data. Developers can use it via Python to create custom voice interfaces, experiment with voice personalization, or integrate into assistive technologies, offering a practical tool for exploring advanced TTS capabilities.

framework_core.name: nautilus_trader
framework_core.summary: Nautilus Trader 是一个高性能算法交易平台，专为需要构建可靠、低延迟交易系统的开发者和研究人员设计。它采用 Rust 语言编写，通过内存安全和高效的事件驱动架构，实现了跨资产类别（如加密货币、股票、期货）的快速回测和实盘交易。技术亮点在于其模块化设计，允许用户轻松集成自定义策略和机器学习模型，并在模拟环境中验证性能。你可以用它开发自动化交易算法，结合市场数据进行分析，或作为研究工具来测试新的量化交易理念。
framework_core.summary_en: Nautilus Trader is a high-performance algorithmic trading platform that solves the challenge of building reliable, low-latency trading systems for professionals and researchers. Its technical strength lies in being written primarily in Rust, which provides memory safety and exceptional speed for event-driven backtesting and live trading across multiple asset classes. You can use it to develop custom trading strategies, integrate machine learning models, and test them with realistic market data simulations before deploying to exchanges like crypto, equities, or forex.

framework_core.name: VoxCPM
framework_core.summary: VoxCPM 是一个开源文本转语音模型，无需语音克隆标记即可生成自然且上下文感知的语音，适用于需要逼真语音合成的场景。其无分词器架构直接处理原始音频波形，实现了更灵活的语音适配，并降低了对大量训练数据的依赖。开发者可通过 Python 使用该模型创建自定义语音界面、尝试语音个性化或集成到辅助技术中，为探索先进 TTS 功能提供了实用工具。
framework_core.summary_en: VoxCPM is an open-source text-to-speech model that generates natural, context-aware speech without requiring voice cloning tokens, making it accessible for applications needing realistic voice synthesis. Its tokenizer-free architecture directly processes raw audio waveforms, enabling more flexible voice adaptation and reducing dependency on extensive training data. Developers can use it via Python to create custom voice interfaces, experiment with voice personalization, or integrate into assistive technologies, offering a practical tool for exploring advanced TTS capabilities.

security_safety.name: cupp
security_safety.summary: CUPP是一个基于Python的密码分析工具，通过模拟真实用户创建密码的习惯来生成针对性字典，用于安全测试。它收集个人信息如姓名、生日和关键词，组合成符合常见模式的密码列表，比随机暴力破解更贴近实际攻击场景。安全人员可用它评估系统防护能力，研究人员则能分析密码行为模式，为设计更安全的身份验证方案提供参考。
security_safety.summary_en: CUPP is a Python-based password profiling tool that generates targeted wordlists for security testing by analyzing common password patterns. It creates personalized dictionaries using information like names, birthdays, and keywords, mimicking how people actually create passwords. Security professionals can use CUPP to test system defenses against realistic attacks, while researchers study password psychology to develop better authentication methods.
